boundaries.dependency_scope: NodeRank, constraint/resource checks, path search and mapper numeric tables remain covered by their frozen differentials; this gate isolates solver ordering and returned mappings.
boundaries.native_clone: Native solves on one private physical clone and proves the const input resources unchanged; Python mapper mutation is not a shared SolverInstance observable.
boundaries.python_isolation: Only exact BaseNodeRankSolver and OrderRankSolver AST nodes execute with minimal deterministic dependency fakes; no learning package is imported.
